title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1667: Endless slaughter (1)

section.p: The sounds of Dragonsrise Drum reverberated throughout the world.
Invincibles had fallen.
Fiery Sea King did not count. He was a traitor. Nobody would mourn his death. But this was different.
Inside the square of Nanyuan mayor’s residence.
Silence descended.
Everyone was shocked. Everyone was confused. Some even started exclaiming in panic.
“The myriad races are attacking!”
Three Invincibles had fallen. This could only happen if the myriad races were attacking! Humanity was finished! The Human Realm was finished!
The myriad race guests were greatly alarmed as well. They all gathered warily, but they didn’t dare to flee.
Just what was going on? Three Invincibles had died.
While sipping his liquor, Su Yu smiled and stepped onto the stage. Overlooking the gathered crowd, he shouted, “Silence.”
Some obeyed. But some continued running around in chaos. Su Yu’s eyes lit up as a burst of aura erupted from his body.
At that, all the people who were running around in chaos coughed blood and collapsed.
Finally, the world was silent.
Su Yu coldly said, “This sky above us. It has yet to fall. Why are you shouting? Pieces of trash.”
His calm was infectious as some calmed significantly after looking at him. He continued, “I’m not dead. I’m still here. Why panic?”

“Great Qin King and the various Invincibles were exterminating the celestial chasm race on my order. So what if a few Invincibles died as a result? Each year, humanity loses many people. Has the fighting ever stopped for us?

“We lost three, but the celestial chasm race will cease to exist. What is there to fear? The myriad races have never given up on destroying us. Today, we shall start with the celestial chasm race and set an example out of them. Why are you shouting? This is war! People die in war! So what if we lose a few founding kings? Even if Great Qin King were to die, so what?”
Su Yu raised his voice, “Has humanity been exterminated? Pieces of trash. Anyone who cries or shouts after this will die. We don’t need pieces of trash like you around.”
The entire world sank into silence.
The crying voices filling the world faded away.
Su Yu’s voice was reverberating throughout the Human Realm. It wasn’t an attack by the myriad races. Rather, it was an attack by humanity. Humanity was exterminating a top ten race.
An ancient race with a Pseudo Emperor.
Only then did the masses understand what was happening.

They still grieved the deaths of three Invincibles, but they were also slightly relieved. Yes, three Invincibles had died. But the celestial chasms had probably lost even more. The human race was ranked higher than the celestial chasm race despite not having a Daofuse.
The myriad race guests also finally understood what was happening. Their expressions changed drastically. The humans…had attacked the celestial chasm race!
How brazen! How bold!
Su Yu’s voice continued to sound throughout the Human Realm.

“Humanity might have lost three Invincibles, but our enemies will lose more! Since today is the day I’m appointed the leader of humanity, my principle of never taking a loss will be applied to humanity as well. For every death my side suffers, I will repay it a hundred times over. Great Qin King and the others are busy exterminating a race. As for me, allow me to make a small demonstration. I shall educate you that Invincibles are nothing.”
With a wave of his arm, he ripped the space in front of him apart.
Then, he stepped into the spatial tunnel that had been prepared for him in advance.
He tossed a glass of hard liquor into the air and said, “I’ll resume drinking after killing a few Invincibles. Anyone daring to leave before I’m back shall be killed.”
He vanished.
Inside the hidden ruin.
The two immortal Invincibles could sense that the entire realm was shaking.
But since they were sheltered by the ruin, they couldn’t feel it too clearly.
The expert with the silverish-white hair frowned and asked, “Fire King, did something happen outside?”
“Something seems to be happening…”

Fire King, the Invincible with the reddish-purple hair, frowned slightly and said, “It felt as though someone was trying to inspect this place earlier. Snow King, is it possible that the ruin has been exposed?”
“Exposed?”
Snow King frowned.
Things had been fine for so many years.

Sure, they had received some items through the teleportation door yesterday. But that was no big deal. They had done something similar in the past. After all, they still required the support of the immortals every now and then when they ran out of resources.

Things had always been fine. Did their latest usage of the teleportation door catch someone’s attention? As for the inspection earlier, the area had been scanned by the humans in the past as well. But the humans had never discovered them. It should be fine.

However, something seemed to be different this time. The outside world was shaking so violently that they could even feel it from inside the ruin. The two looked at each other silently, wondering if they should send someone to investigate.

Apart from them, there were over a hundred immortal experts in the ruin as well. There were several Pseudo Invincibles and dozens of Sunmoons among them. This was enough fighting force to give the human race a significant stab on their back during an important battle.
Would it be too risky for them to send someone out now? The two sank into silence.

Just then, the air around the destroyed teleportation door started warping. Snow King frowned in confusion, but Fire King’s expression changed drastically as he roared, “Get ready to kill! Someone is trying to force their way through!”
Finally, Snow King’s expression changed as well. Only Eternals could force their way through space in such a manner.
Which Eternal was coming?
The two released their strength without any hesitation.
Right at that moment, Su Yu emerged from the crack in the air. He looked around coldly and noted that there were two Invincibles in the vicinity.
Two.
A sixth degree and a seventh degree.
These were powerful enemies.
Su Yu couldn’t be bothered to waste time fighting them personally. He needed to finish this fast and win the acknowledgment of the other humans if he wanted to keep humanity calm.
“Lord Flat!”
Next, a terrifyingly powerful devouring force erupted from the Mark of Civilization. Just as the two Invincibles were done mustering their snow and fire, they paled.
“Daofuse!”
A Daofuse had arrived!
Their seas of willpower shook violently from the devouring force. Not everyone was Great Qin King. Not everyone could resist the attacks of Daofuses without being a Daofuse.

Great Qin King and Great Zhou King were different. They were the main pillars of humanity. They were existences capable of fighting against Daofuses. Meanwhile, the two immortals here were far weaker than they.

In mere moments, the eyes of the two immortals turned blank. Their Rivers of Time only appeared for a split second before snapping apart. And finally, the Mark of Civilization descended upon the two and dragged them inside the book.
As for the Sunmoons who were fleeing everywhere in the ruin, Su Yu merely roared before throwing countless fists at them.
In the blink of an eye, over a hundred experts collapsed while coughing blood. Next, the Mark of Civilization dragged all of them inside the book as well.
All that had finished in the blink of an eye.
Before anyone could react, Su Yu had returned to Nanyuan.

Some of the people there were still looking at the glass of liquor he threw in the air when he returned with his crown on his head. He coldly said, “Some nobodies dare to covet the Human Realm. Death is their punishment. They shall serve as sacrifice for our dead Invincibles.”
Then, two Invincibles appeared out of thin air.
“Snow King!”
“Fire King!”
Some of the myriad race guests paled upon realizing who the two were.
Su Yu nonchalantly threw a punch.
He only threw his punch once, but countless fists shot forth.
Snow King was blasted apart. The moment his second body appeared, it was blasted apart again. And finally, his third body was blasted apart as well.
Crimson clouds covered the sky while the entire world shook.

Su Yu moved on to Fire King without a change in expression. This was a seventh-degree Eternal, an expert stronger than Snow King. A look of struggle could be seen in his eyes as he had regained some of his clarity. However, he was completely incapable of resisting. He could only watch with fear and despair.
Why? Because a Daofuse was personally keeping him still.
In the blink of an eye, all three of his bodies were blasted apart by Su Yu.
Done with the two, Su Yu sent his Mark of Civilization forth and consumed all the blood and flesh in the air.
Four carrier treasures were left behind.
Su Yu casually tossed two of them to the Great Yue prefect and the Great Liang prefect. Each was given one.
Su Yu looked up at the crimson clouds in the sky, “How brazen of the immortals to send only two Invincibles into the Human Realm. They are now enjoying themselves in the afterlife. You’re welcome.”
Everyone in the Human Realm could hear Su Yu’s voice. Everyone could see the crimson clouds in the sky.
Invincibles.
Dead Invincibles.

Those with better eyesight could even see that the intensity of the crimson clouds indicated that the two dead Invincibles weren’t regular Invincibles. The two were powerful even by the standards of Invincibles.
In short, Su Yu…was terrifyingly strong.
And terrifyingly savage.
The myriad race guests. Those from the thirty-six prefectures. Even the other human Invincibles. All were greatly shocked.
Was this really Su Yu?
Did he just kill the two Invincibles?
Was this a joke?
One of the two was a seventh-degree Eternal!
Next, numerous immortal Sunmoons and Mountainseas were released from the Mark of Civilization. With a casual slap, Su Yu turned them all into mincemeat. Moons started raining from the sky.
He had killed them all with only one strike.

Once again, the Mark of Civilization swept forth and consumed everything. Two more carrier treasures dropped onto the ground. One of them was the carrier treasure Su Yu had transferred to them previously. As for the heaven weapon he had transferred to them, it was nowhere to be seen. Perhaps it was being stored in a storage ring. He had not bothered to search.
After putting the two carrier treasures away, Su Yu asked, “Did King Hong leave any descendants behind?”
“Yes.”

Su Yu nodded and said, “They will receive two carrier treasures. King Hong died fighting for humanity. His descendants deserve this. Today, their Invincible died. I will grant them two carrier treasures. May their line produce another Invincible.”
Amid the crowd, Zhu Tiandao looked around before shouting, “The holy lord is wise! With such a wise holy lord, no human will be too afraid to fight!”
“The holy lord is wise!”
Everyone roared.
This was what they needed. Something to grant them courage during such a difficult time.
The deaths of three Invincibles had greatly terrified them.
But when Su Yu killed two immortal kings, dozens of Sunmoons, and numerous Mountainseas, some started calming down.
Their panic lessened.
He was too strong.
Some even started to believe that Su Yu was stronger than Great Qin King. That was too scary. He could kill Invincibles like it was a game. With such a holy lord around, what was there to fear?
Yes, they had lost three Invincibles. But Su Yu was here! One ought to know that the number of Invincibles he alone had killed was pushing three digits.
Meanwhile, the human Invincibles had yet to recover from their shock. Just how did Su Yu accomplish that?
Only then did Su Yu catch the glass of liquor he had thrown upward earlier. After draining the glass in one gulp, he roared, “Go! Spread out! Kill anyone suspicious!”
“Yes!”
With that, the human Invincibles shot out in different directions.

Once again, Su Yu’s voice reverberated throughout the Human Realm, “War is upon us. Peace is over. There is only war. We fight. We fight the Myriad Realms. We kill the myriad races. That is the only path of survival.”
“During the past hundred thousand years, humanity had suffered nine defeats in a row. This is the tenth epoch. This is our last chance. We must win. We shall win.”
Next, numerous roars rang out.
“YES!”
“YES!”
Everyone was stirred by the prowess Su Yu had displayed. He could kill Invincibles like it was nothing. Because of that, many started believing that humanity would be fine so long as he was around.
The sacrifice of two immortal kings was surprisingly effective. The previous panic was suppressed. Everyone was full of confidence in their new holy lord.
Next, Su Yu addressed the myriad race guests, “This won’t affect you if your races remain neutral. Otherwise, you can also serve as the sacrifice to our banner.”
Numerous faces paled at those words.
How terrifying.
This was a fiend.
A devil more devilish than the devils. For him, Invincibles were akin to bugs. He would show nobody mercy.
Such an existence was too terrifying. For many, the sight today was one that they could never forget.
Then, Su Yu removed his attention from the myriad race guests. The thirty-six prefectures had plenty of experts. These experts were enough to handle some guests.
Instead, Su Yu’s attention was focused elsewhere.
He did not leave.
He waited.
The hidden danger within the Human Realm must be dealt with. By killing the two immortal kings, the immortals would be alerted that their plan had been exposed.

However, Su Yu had to do so. Even if he had to alert the myriad races before finding all the hidden ruins, he had to do it. That was the only way to avoid widespread panic in the Human Realm. His choice would most likely force the other hidden experts to emerge in advance.
Thus, he waited. He was waiting to kill them. With the female furball around, he was confident in his ability to handle them. He could only hope that no Daofuse would arrive before then.
